script_text: Something massive is shifting beneath your surface, Scorpio. Early week brings Pluto in your 8th House trining Saturn, sharpening your financial instincts — avoid impulsive purchases Monday and Tuesday. Mars squares your ruling planet Pluto on Wednesday, creating intense emotional pressure around shared resources or inheritances, but Venus sextiles Neptune Thursday bringing unexpected romantic revelations in your 5th House of love. Friday marks the turning point as the Sun opposes Pluto, forcing hidden truths into the open across all relationships. The weekend brings Mercury entering your 10th House, boosting career visibility — perfect timing for that big presentation or job discussion. Wednesday is your power day because Mars-Pluto aspects ignite your magnetic presence. Saturday is challenging as emotional intensity may overwhelm practical thinking. This week, set clear boundaries around money discussions to avoid conflict. Follow for daily updates.
